title.rendered: Oman is turning its energy scale into investable strength

content.rendered:
At the Arqaam Capital MENA Investor Conference 2025, the session Unlocking Oman’s Energy and Capital Potential spotlighted how OQ’s integrated value chain—from upstream to downstream—is shaping both the country’s energy future and its capital market trajectory.

Moderated by Lamya Harub, acting Head of Listed Assets & Investor Relations at QQ Group, the panel featured Jaber Al Namaani (QQEP), Khaled Al Asmi (QQBI), Mansoor Ali Al-Abdali (OQGN), and Tarik Al-jumaido (OOMCO).

From a solar-powered bunkering facility in Sohar and gas delivery networks with over 133 industrial connections, to methanol and ammonia expansion plans and hydrogen transport corridors, OQ is activating its full chain of capabilities. The listing of OQGN on the Muscat Stock Exchange S.A.O.C in October 2023 marked a strategic step in connecting industrial infrastructure to long-term capital.

Panelists emphasised that hydrocarbons will continue to play a funding role for Oman’s green transition but with lower emissions, better efficiency, and a strong focus on integration.

Backed by diversification policy, regulatory momentum, and investor-focused reforms, Oman is reinforcing its position as a rising hub for energy and capital, drawing new global interest in the process.
